description: Search property listings on nieruchomosci-online.pl, one of Poland's largest real-estate portals: flats, houses, plots, commercial premises and rooms, for sale or for rent, filtered by city/district or voivodeship, price, area, rooms and private-owner-only. Returns one results page (~40 listings) with each listing's price, price per m², area, rooms, floor, location, seller type and link; pass a listing `id` to nieruchomosci_online_offer for the full details. Fetched live from nieruchomosci-online.pl (typically 1–3 s via direct fetch; up to ~20 s when it falls back to an unblocker). Result shape: { source, fetchedAt, query, search_url, heading, resolved_location, total_count, page, total_pages, count, listings: [...], note? } — the list key is `listings`; `total_count` counts matches across all pages (use `page` for more). Each listing: { id, url, title, kind, market, price, price_per_m2, currency, area_m2, rooms, floor, location, street, city, region, seller_type, image, description }. Prices are numbers in PLN (for rent, `price` is the monthly rent) and area is in m²; fields are null when the page omits them. `kind` is 'new_development' for a developer's unit in a new project (primary market), else 'listing'; `seller_type` is agency | private | developer | company. An empty match answers count: 0 with a `note` saying why and what to change — that is a successful result, not an error.

area_max.description: Maximum area in m² (the plot's area for type 'plot').

area_min.description: Minimum area in m² (the plot's area for type 'plot').

location.description: City in Polish spelling, optionally followed by a district: 'Kraków', 'Warszawa Mokotów', 'Gdańsk Wrzeszcz'. English names ('Warsaw') are not recognised. Omit to search all of Poland, or pass region instead.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh fetch and bypass this server's result cache (5 min). Default false.

page.description: Results page, 1-based (~40 listings per page). Default 1.

price_max.description: Maximum total price in PLN (monthly rent when transaction is 'rent').

price_min.description: Minimum total price in PLN (monthly rent when transaction is 'rent').

private_only.description: Only listings posted by private owners (bez pośredników) — no agencies or developers. Default false.

region.description: A whole voivodeship instead of a city, e.g. 'malopolskie', 'mazowieckie'. Not combinable with location.

rooms_max.description: Maximum number of rooms — types 'flat' and 'house' only (use min = max for exactly N).

rooms_min.description: Minimum number of rooms — types 'flat' and 'house' only.

transaction.description: 'sale' = na sprzedaż (buying), 'rent' = na wynajem (renting; prices are monthly).

type.description: Property type: 'flat' = mieszkanie, 'house' = dom, 'plot' = działka (land), 'commercial' = lokal użytkowy (office, shop, premises), 'commercial_building' = budynek użytkowy, 'room' = pokój (a room to rent).

name: nieruchomosci_online_search
title: Search Polish real-estate listings (nieruchomosci-online.pl)
